newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 355,400 metric tons (MT) were 2 percent more than the previous week, but 15 percent less than the 4-week average.
Major increases were reported for unknown destinations (83,500 MT), Japan (60,500 MT), Israel (32,400 MT), South Africa (32,100 MT), and Venezuela (29,500 MT).

Exports of 337,800 MT were off 27 percent from the week earlier and 12 percent from the 4-week average. The principal recipients were Israel (54,200 MT), Mexico (52,800 MT), Pakistan (52,500 MT), Taiwan (25,700 MT), Lebanon (22,000 MT), and Japan (20,500 MT).
